title: titan-sr-jev-replication: TypeSafe Jev screening of the TITAN-SR external validation set (22 Cochrane reviews)
description: Replication package that scores the 22-review, 142,504-record temporal external validation set of TITAN-SR (Pitre et al., J Clin Epidemiol 2026) with the TypeSafe jev-1.13.0 screening model, as used by the TiAb Review Plugin. Includes the code, the per-record output ledgers, the compressed scores and the generated report. Input data are rebuilt from the public Chan et al. 2025 dataset (CC BY 4.0) and verified by SHA-256.
